canonical_source.behavior: When Href is non-blank, AppButton renders an anchor with EffectiveHref, Target, Title, aria-disabled, aria-busy, aria-label, aria-pressed, and disabled tabindex semantics. EffectiveHref is null while disabled, preventing navigation. Blank Href falls through to the native button branch.

laravel_adaptation.runtime_consumer: none required for the shared component contract
laravel_adaptation.behavior: The production React AppButton now renders the source-equivalent anchor branch for non-blank href values, preserves href/target/title and accessibility state, removes href and keyboard focus when disabled, and falls back to the already-terminal native-button branch for blank href values. Consumer canonical identity remains distinct from the shared link-operation identity.

authorization.reason: This shared link control neither grants permissions nor performs a backend mutation; route authorization remains the responsibility of the destination and the authorized consumer that supplies the href.

tenant_isolation.proof: The component derives no tenant or resource identifier and performs no lookup. It renders only the href supplied by its already-authorized consumer.

degraded_and_retry_semantics.disabled: Disabled link mode fails closed by omitting href and setting tabindex=-1 plus aria-disabled=true.
degraded_and_retry_semantics.busy: aria-busy is exposed without fabricating completion or navigation success.
degraded_and_retry_semantics.retry: No retry or idempotency behavior is introduced because the shared control performs no mutation or request.

acceptance_tests.coverage: exact canonical marker, native anchor rendering, effective href/target/title, busy/pressed accessibility, disabled fail-closed href removal and tabindex, blank-href fallback, and consumer/shared identity separation
regression guard for the already-terminal AIMW-PLAT-57E0113F24 non-link click/button contract

terminality.basis: Source-equivalent AppButton link behavior is implemented in the production React shared component and covered by focused deterministic acceptance, including fail-closed disabled navigation and preservation of the previously terminal button branch.
